This is a list of video games for the [[PlayStation 3]] [[video game console]] that have sold or shipped at least one million copies.

As of May 12, 2025, a total of over one{{nbsp}}billion copies of PlayStation 3 software had been sold worldwide.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sie.com/en/corporate/data.html|title=Business Development - PlayStation Software|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201214141927/https://www.sie.com/en/corporate/data.html|archive-date=December 14, 2020|publisher=[[Sony Interactive Entertainment]]}}</ref>
